description: This file defines the StringUtils class with static methods for string manipulation, including camelCase conversions and translations, within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string operations such as camelCase to snake_case conversion, translation lookup, and camel case splitting.

methods.name: camelToUnderscoreCase
methods.description: Converts a camelCase string to snake_case, optionally uppercase.

methods.name: camelToTranslation
methods.description: Attempts to find a translation label for a camel-cased string, or formats it into a human-readable string.

methods.name: explodeCamelCase
methods.description: Splits a camelCase string into its component words.
